name: Serpent Tagger
summary:
Serpent Taggers 

Slither, swing, and sprint your way through Serpent Taggers, a fast-paced, movement-based tag game. Use pure movement and momentum to climb, vault, and launch yourself across unique environments built for speed and creativity. Whether you're exploring maps, racing friends, or testing new mechanics, Serpent Taggers delivers a simple, skill-based, and addictive experience.

Featuring smooth locomotion, multiplayer support, custom map
